ledger_scope: Flagged material claims and ambiguities, after reading all six held-out summary/synthesis outputs against supplied sources. Supported content is described through coverage and review notes; not an exhaustive standardized atomic-claim denominator.
annotation_limits: Qualification loss, event contradiction, citation drift, attribution and ambiguity remain distinct. Flag counts are not independent false-fact totals or comparable precision percentages.
configuration_review: All 12 requests completed normally at 32768 context. Full-source prompt 13916 tokens and output 672; synthesis output 1754 tokens. Neither stage hit the 2048-token cap.
citation_review: All 16 stated extraction answers have supporting page sets; H3-Q3 and H4-Q2 are incomplete despite correct cited fragments. Fifteen have marked quotations. Summary admission request spans 61–62; wounded care belongs on 245 rather than 244. The full-source control’s broad paragraph citations are often incomplete or wrong: admission conditions on 63 rather than 61, food/affray on 63–64 rather than 62, battle/deaths on 66–67 rather than 65, Christian reforms/monasticism on 171–175 rather than 170, and Timur/urban conditions on 360–366 rather than 358.
supported_content_review: Direct H2 preserves the only significant Latin regions qualification, native Latin for Justinian, Telemachus’s individual action and attributed monastic critique. Ending infanticide follows the source’s explicit phrasing on 171/173. H3 preserves both disgrace and surprise qualification, rather than exonerating administrative failure, and the longer literary recovery. H4 preserves failed blinding, Mohammed’s maintenance of Manuel’s gains, source JohnVI and limited Western aid;1425 is supported by 1422 plus three years.
synthesis_review: Merged synthesis copies nearly all four parent summaries, propagating all six clear parent error families. Its length greatly exceeds the requested 350–450 words, despite stopping below the output cap. The independent control correctly restores the food direction but repeats the vanished-Latin qualification loss, adds two new clear families, omits all H3, and loses seven of 16 compound coverage units. No numeric overall quality score is inferred from these counts.
